paper_title: An S-shaped thienoacene semiconductor forming unique cruciform lamellar packing via a 2D interaction network of π-stacking and chalcogen bonding

knowledge_points.content: S-B2T4 is a crooked thienoacene molecule consisting of four fused thiophene rings and two benzene rings in an S-shaped configuration, functionalized with two terminal octyl chains for improved solubility.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this study, we designed and synthesized a new crooked thienoacene, S-B2T4 (Fig. 1c), by fusing four thiophene and two benzene rings in an S-shaped configuration and attaching two terminal octyl chains.

knowledge_points.content: The central thieno[3,2-b]thiophene moiety in S-B2T4 is synthesized through a sequence involving dilithiation with n-BuLi, followed by reaction with elemental sulfur and reduction with copper powder.
knowledge_points.evidence: Finally, the central thieno[3,2-b]thiophene moiety was constructed via a two-step procedure: dilithiation with n-BuLi, followed by the addition of elemental sulfur, and reduction with Cu powder.

knowledge_points.content: Solution-processed thin-film organic field-effect transistors (OFETs) using S-B2T4 achieve a maximum hole mobility of 1.5 cm²/V·s and on/off current ratios between 10^4 and 10^5.
knowledge_points.evidence: As a result, S-B2T4-based thin-film OFETs exhibited hole mobilities as high as 1.5 cm2 V−1 s−1... on/off current ratios (Ion/Ioff) of 10^4–10^5.

knowledge_points.content: S-B2T4 possesses a HOMO energy level of -5.41 eV and an optical energy gap of 3.50 eV, the latter being larger than its linear isomer S-DNTT-n due to the cross-conjugation character of the syn-fused thiophenes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) energy level of S-B2T4 was determined to be -5.41 eV... The optical energy gap (Eg) estimated from the absorption edge in the thin film was 3.50 eV, which is larger than that of S-DNTT-n (3.22–3.23 eV), presumably because of the cross-conjugation character of the S-B2T4 π-core derived from the syn-fused thiophenes.

knowledge_points.content: S-B2T4 molecules self-organize into a cruciform lamellar packing arrangement where adjacent molecules are orthogonally positioned, stabilized by sulfur–sulfur (S···S) interactions and π-stacking.
knowledge_points.evidence: In each lamellar layer, adjacent S-B2T4 molecules are orthogonally arranged to form a cruciform molecular array. The extended 2D interaction network via π-stacking and chalcogen bonding is crucial for stabilizing such molecular packing.

knowledge_points.content: Single-crystal X-ray analysis of S-B2T4 reveals an intermolecular S···S distance of 3.55 Å, which is shorter than the sum of the van der Waals radii (3.60 Å), and a π-stacking distance of 3.47 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: The neighboring intermolecular S···S distance is 3.55 Å, which is shorter than the sum of the van der Waals radii (3.60 Å). Meanwhile, π-stackings with a distance of 3.47 Å were observed along the b-axis direction.

knowledge_points.content: Natural bond orbital (NBO) analysis confirms chalcogen bonding in S-B2T4 through charge-transfer from the sulfur lone-pair orbital (n_s) to the antibonding σ* orbital of S-C bonds, with stabilization energies of 0.28 and 0.51 kcal/mol.
knowledge_points.evidence: The key NBOs describe the charge-transfer interactions between the lone-pair orbital of the sulfur atom (ns) in molecule A and the antibonding orbital of the S-C bonds (σ*S-C) in molecule B, with stabilization energies of 0.28 and 0.51 kcal mol−1, which are characteristic of typical chalcogen bondings.

knowledge_points.content: S-B2T4 exhibits high solubility in toluene (> 5 g/L at 25 °C), which is significantly greater than other six-ring-fused thienoacenes like C10-DNTT (~0.08 g/L at 60 °C), enabling thin-film fabrication via room-temperature dip coating.
knowledge_points.evidence: The solubility of S-B2T4 was much higher (> 5 g L−1 at 25 °C in toluene) than those of other six-ring-fused thienoacenes such as C10-DNTT (~0.08 g L−1 at 60 °C in toluene)... continuous thin films based on S-B2T4 can be produced by dip coating... at room temperature.

knowledge_points.content: The charge transport in S-B2T4 thin films is nearly isotropic, with hole mobilities of 1.1 cm²/V·s parallel and 1.0 cm²/V·s perpendicular to the sample pulling direction, attributed to the 2D interaction network in the crystalline state.
knowledge_points.evidence: The hole mobilities were 1.1 and 1.0 cm2 V−1 s−1 for the || and ⊥ directions, respectively... The direction-independent transport behavior could be ascribed to the 2D intermolecular interactions of S-B2T4 in the crystalline state.

knowledge_points.content: Out-of-plane XRD of dip-coated S-B2T4 films shows a d-spacing of 2.44 nm and intense (00h) peaks, indicating that the molecules adopt an edge-on orientation vertically aligned to the substrate.
knowledge_points.evidence: The series of intense (00h) diffraction peaks with a d-spacing of 2.44 nm in the XRD pattern indicated that the S-B2T4 molecules are oriented vertically with respect to the substrate... supporting the edge-on molecular orientation on the substrates.

knowledge_points.content: The calculated intermolecular transfer integrals for S-B2T4 are -9 meV along the a-axis (S···S interaction direction) and -29 meV along the b-axis (π-stacking direction).
knowledge_points.evidence: intermolecular transfer integrals were calculated to be -9 meV along the a-axis (S···S interaction direction) and -29 meV along the b-axis (π-stacking direction).

knowledge_points.content: S-B2T4 shows high thermal stability with a 5% weight-loss temperature (Td) of 371 °C measured under nitrogen atmosphere.
knowledge_points.evidence: Thermogravimetric analysis demonstrated the high thermal stability of S-B2T4, with a 5% weight-loss temperature (Td) of 371 °C under a N2 atmosphere.
